consent_what_body.message: Veridex checks product pages for scam shops, generic factory goods sold as a brand, fake discounts and pushy tricks such as fake countdowns, and explains what it found in plain words.

consent_sent_body.message: Only when you click “Analyse this page”: the product facts and the cleaned visible text of that page go to unfret.kroshtan.com. Never your account details or anything you typed. Page addresses aren't stored, nothing is sold and there are no affiliate links. Product prices are kept anonymously for 90 days to spot fake discounts.

consent_pay_body.message: You sign in with a Solana wallet and use prepaid checks. A new wallet may get a free trial check.

opt_server_help.message: The default is https://unfret.kroshtan.com. For development, the dev server (https://dev.unfret.kroshtan.com), http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1 (any port) can be used; the browser asks you to allow access to it.

opt_only_https.message: Only https:// URLs, or http://localhost / http://127.0.0.1, are allowed.

opt_denied.message: Access to that address was not allowed; keeping the previous server.

opt_privacy_body.message: Veridex reads a page only when you click "Analyse this page". It then sends the product facts and the page's visible product text (without account menus, addresses or forms) to the Veridex server. It stores only your sign-in session, your consent and these settings in your browser, and no analysis history.
